name: @etzhayyim/open-water-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of open-water (public water-utility infrastructure open-data: reservoirs + mains + leak reports + quality samples) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces D1). Axis-clean public open-data; no PII/settlement. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
